name: pediment-website
description: Demo and showcase site for the Pediment site engine.

scripts.env:start: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp theme activate pediment-website && wp-env run cli wp plugin activate pediment-plugin && wp-env run cli wp rewrite structure '/%postname%/' --hard && wp-env run cli wp option update blogname 'Pediment'
scripts.languages: wp-env run cli wp pediment languages
scripts.seed:plan: wp-env run cli wp pediment seed --dry-run
scripts.seed: wp-env run cli wp pediment seed
scripts.adopt: wp-env run cli wp pediment adopt
